header.title: Skeleton
header.description: Animated placeholder that takes the place of content while it loads. `variant` sets the shape, `count` stacks text lines and `isLoaded` shows the real content. If you wrap the content, the placeholder takes its size and the layout doesn't jump on load.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the placeholder and the code. The default accessible name is `Loading`; pass `aria-label` to describe what's loading.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: With no props it shows a text line with the `wave` animation. Each Skeleton is announced as `role="status"` with the name `Loading`: pass a more specific `aria-label` when possible.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` sets the shape: `text` (line, default), `circular` (2.5 rem disc) or `rectangular` (6 rem tall block).

textLines.title: Text lines
textLines.description: `count` stacks lines (1 to 32). `gap` sets the space between them and `lastLineWidth` the width of the last one, 72% by default so it looks like a paragraph.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: `animation` accepts `wave` (default), `pulse` or `none`. `duration` sets the cycle in milliseconds (1600 by default). With reduced motion, the animation stops.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: `radius` rounds the corners: `none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` or `full`. The default depends on the variant: `sm` for text, `md` for rectangular and `full` for circular.

customSize.title: Custom size
customSize.description: `width` and `height` accept a number (pixels) or any CSS length. For `circular`, if you only pass `width`, the height takes the same value.

card.title: Card
card.description: Combine variants to mimic the final layout. To avoid one announcement per piece, put `role="status"` and a name on the container, and `aria-hidden` on each Skeleton.

loaded.title: Loaded content
loaded.description: With `children`, the placeholder takes the size of the (hidden) content while loading. With `isLoaded` the content is shown in its place, without adding boxes to the layout.

person.name: Lucy Romero
person.summary: Team activity from the last 24 hours, including reviews and shipping notes.

fit.title: Fit to content
fit.description: Wrap any element, such as a heading, a badge or a button, and the placeholder copies its exact size. With `children`, `count` is ignored and a single placeholder is shown.

list.title: List
list.description: A common case: placeholder rows while a list arrives. In this example there's a single `role="status"` for the whole list and the placeholders are hidden from screen readers.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` (or `isDisabled`) stops the animation and leaves the placeholder static.

header.title: Skeleton API
header.description: API reference for the Skeleton React component: props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `toSkeletonLength` turns a number into pixels and passes any other CSS length through.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts <div> attributes and they go to the container along with ref, id, className and style. classNames adds classes to root, bone (each placeholder) and content (the hidden content). With isLoaded, the container uses display: contents, so its box styles don't apply.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.status: While loading, the container has role="status", aria-busy="true" and aria-live="polite". If you pass another role, aria-live isn't added.
a11y.label: The default name is "Loading". Pass aria-label or aria-labelledby to describe what's loading.
a11y.group: With several Skeletons together, each one is a status region. Put role="status" and a name on the container, and aria-hidden on each Skeleton.
a11y.loaded: With isLoaded, role, aria-busy and the name are removed, and the content is visible to everyone.
a11y.fit: The content that sizes the placeholder has aria-hidden and visibility: hidden while loading.
a11y.disabled: disabled only stops the animation and adds data-disabled. It's still announced as loading.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Container. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.variant: Shape: `--text`, `--circular` or `--rectangular`. Sets height, radius and, for circular, width.
rules.stack: Applied when `count` is greater than 1. Stacks placeholders with `--gem-skeleton-gap`.
rules.fit: Applied with `children` while loading. The placeholder takes the content size.
rules.paused: Applied with `disabled` or `isDisabled`. Stops the animation.
rules.content: Hidden content that provides the size. Receives `classNames.content`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Skeleton's own variables. Variant and radius classes have the same specificity, so use `.gem-skeleton.your-class` and a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant. Some are set inline from props and can't be overridden with a class.

items.--gem-skeleton-duration: Cycle duration. Always set inline from `duration`, so change it with the prop.
items.--gem-skeleton-w: Width. Set inline when you pass `width`.
items.--gem-skeleton-h: Height. Set by the variant or, inline, by `height`.
items.--gem-skeleton-radius: Radius. Set by the variant and `radius`.
items.--gem-skeleton-gap: Gap between lines. Set inline when you pass `gap`.
items.--gem-skeleton-last-w: Last line width. Set inline when you pass `lastLineWidth`.

items.--gem-color-neutral-200: Placeholder color, in light and dark.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.radius: Corner radius. The default depends on `variant`.
items.width: Width of each placeholder. A number is in pixels.
items.height: Height of each placeholder. For `circular`, if missing, it uses `width`.
items.count: Number of stacked placeholders, 1 to 32. Ignored with `children`.
items.gap: Space between placeholders when `count` is greater than 1.
items.lastLineWidth: Width of the last text line when `count` is greater than 1.
items.children: Content that sizes the placeholder while loading and is shown with `isLoaded`.
items.aria-labelledby: Id of an element that names the placeholder.
items.aria-live: Announcement politeness. Only added automatically if you don't pass `role`.
items.aria-hidden: Hides the placeholder from screen readers. Useful when the container already announces loading.
